notes.title: How to fix game over in the dungeon stage
notes.notes:
We would like to let you know that, due to a design flaw, we failed to explain to players that if they argue with Gregory in the tower (before going up the stairs to Tuke's lair), then no one will help them out of the dungeon. 

In this respect, the mistake is that this is not clear to the player: you can only complete the game if you don't argue with Gregory.

notes.title: Tragala now available
notes.notes:
Tragala is now available on Steam!

This project is a small authorial proposal that I hope you like it. 

Some features of the game:

[list]
[*] Tragala proposes the player to get into the skin of Kurt, a restless young man trying to escape from the house-system.
[*] The meta-game mode includes cinematics related to real situations, some of the poems I wrote about tragala, and a complementary ending to the classic mode.
[*] The proposal is full of humor. 
[/list]

More info: https://zoozobra.com/tragala/

notes.title: Release date announced
notes.notes:
I'm very happy to announce that Tragala will be released next [b]September 3rd[/b] on Steam!

The adventure game, in which I try to bring my “anti-Tragala” narrative universe to the art of videogame, will be released at a [b]reduced price[/b] of 5,99$.

More info: https://zoozobra.com/tragala/

notes.title: Demo now available
notes.notes:
You can already play the Traga demo!

The game will participate in the Steam Next Fest, proposing a graphic adventure in which the player will play the role of Kurt, a restless young man trying to escape from the house-system ruled by the junjuma, a control and guilt machine that is connected to a systematic and terrible monster known as tragala.

Read more: https://zoozobra.com/tragala/
